decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that extends the firm's core track system, the adapter preserves option value and customer-system compatibility with little downside to keeping it in the range.

A single LED luminaire with only limited visibility after launch has likely revealed its market potential by 2022, so the option value of keeping it open appears lower than the benefit of reallocating resources.

The home automation server box is strategically interesting but software- and support-intensive, and with only weak evidence of traction since launch its downside from continued maintenance likely outweighs remaining uncertainty.

A luminaire family presented with its own page fits the firm's premium core offer and can be carried through existing channels, so the cost of continuing is modest relative to its assortment and brand value.

As a LED luminaire family close to the established business in a growing market, it is sensible to keep this option open because it likely shares components, channels, and brand logic with the core range.
A LED spotlight series is close to the firm's core lighting portfolio and likely inexpensive to continue relative to its usefulness for installers, planners, and showroom breadth.
